title: BNY and Citadel Complete a Tokenized Treasury Repo Workflow
why_it_matters: The reported sequence links asset acquisition to collateral funding, demonstrating an operational use beyond issuing or holding a blockchain token.

BNY and Citadel Complete a Tokenized Treasury Repo Workflow
